apps.name: Bitcoin Dashboard
apps.description: Bitcoin CAD price, chart, and network dashboard for the PocketCHIP.
apps.compatibility_notes: Requires Python 3.8+ and system Tkinter with Tk 8.6. Native installation and process-based window focus verified on the Debian 13 PocketCHIP with Vitrallis Shell.

apps.name: Carousel-Rust
apps.description: Rust media carousel for PocketCHIP sharing the Python photo library, with accelerated playback and LAN management.
apps.compatibility_notes: Requires ARMv7 hard-float Linux, glibc 2.36+, SDL2, Mali/Lima graphics, a VSync X11 compositor and Vitrallis Shell 0.1.0-beta3.1 or newer with native Rust runtime support. WebM uses system ffmpeg/ffprobe. PocketCHIP GPU playback, physical moving-bar presentation, keyboard controls, codec parity and shared Python/Rust storage were verified. Close the Python carousel before launch.

apps.name: Vitrallis Debug
apps.description: Offline Linux hardware and driver diagnostics with CPU/GPU graphs and a hardware-rendered Pulse.
apps.compatibility_notes: Requires Linux, Python 3.8+ and system Tkinter. Pulse additionally requires X11/XWayland, EGL/GLES2 and a compatible hardware driver. Real Lima utilization, GPU frequency, keyboard controls and overlay performance were tested on PocketCHIP. GPU access and tear-free presentation require the Shell PocketCHIP platform setup with its private trace reader and VSync compositor. Managed App Center update to this version was not physically exercised.

apps.name: Firefly Field
apps.description: A calm, fullscreen pixel-art firefly meadow rendered through SDL2.
apps.compatibility_notes: Requires Python 3.8+ and system SDL2 2.0+ with an X11/Wayland/video driver. Auto tries VSync accelerated renderers before bounded software fallback; SDL 2.0.18+ enables sprite batching. Physical Mali/Lima menu performance and synchronized presentation were tested on PocketCHIP with the Shell VSync compositor. Managed App Center update to this version was not physically exercised.

apps.name: Places
apps.description: A native first-person exploration game through an office, empty pool and unfinished interior on PocketCHIP.
apps.compatibility_notes: Requires PocketCHIP ARMv7 hard-float Linux, glibc 2.36+, SDL2 2.32+, Mali/Lima OpenGL ES 2.0 and X11. App Manager install, update and repair of this edition still need device verification.

apps.name: Vitrallis Media Carousel
apps.description: Native media slideshow with LAN uploads, named collections and shared settings.
apps.compatibility_notes: Requires Python 3.9+, Tk 8.6, Pillow >=10.4,<13, qrcode >=7.4,<9 and installed packaging for App Center dependency checks. Optional system ffmpeg/ffprobe must decode VP8, VP9 and WebP; one-click setup requires the Shell multimedia helper. PocketCHIP playback, uploads and keyboard controls were tested from staged source with the Shell VSync compositor. Managed App Center update to this version was not physically exercised.
